overview.limits: Current NASA overview of the five IAU-recognized dwarf planets; recognition status can change.

ceres.limits: Rounded public-facing values; radius, day, orbit and axial tilt are approximate.

pluto.limits: Rounded public-facing values; moon count and named moons reflect the page snapshot.

haumea.limits: Rounded public-facing values; discovery credit remains disputed and is excluded.

makemake.limits: Page updated 2026-10-26; rounded values and one provisional moon.

eris.limits: Rounded public-facing values; conflicting diameter values on other NASA pages are excluded.

moons.limits: Page updated 2026-10-13; moon counts are time-dependent and require 90-day review.
